title: Origin story: Coyote
description: Coyote is the trickster of many Native American traditions — creator and fool at once. He stole fire for the people, placed the stars, and shaped the world, usually by accident or appetite. His stories teach by negative example: Coyote's failures are the people's lessons.

title: Stamina feats: Coyote
